research_question: Can a covariance-weighted HJ/GMM training loss learn a pricing direction that transfers from size-value portfolios to held-out industries?
pricing_loss: ridge HJ squared distance normalized by the zero-factor ridge HJ squared distance
validation_selection_rule: Using 2000-2009 only, retain candidates with factor Sharpe at least 1.5 and select the lowest held-out 49-industry ridge HJ distance; break ties by lower held-out mean absolute alpha, then the smaller penalty.
development_promotion_rule: On 2010-2019, the selected model must improve both combined-74 and held-out-industry ridge HJ and mean absolute alpha by at least five percent relative to the validation-selected FF5-plus-momentum baseline while retaining factor Sharpe above that baseline.
boundary: Only size-value portfolios enter the neural training loss. Industry returns are held out from training and used for validation selection and development generalization. No five-seed run is authorized unless the promotion rule passes.
